page_title: MAL 1-1 OSA | Mallorca v Osasuna 10/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Dominik Greif leaps to intercept the corner kick from Kike Barja (Osasuna). The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
90+6' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+4' 1 - 1 Goal! Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.
90+1' None of the Osasuna players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing. Good work from Osasuna as they win a corner.
90' The referee gives a yellow card to Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Ruben Garcia and he is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
89' Substitution. Jose Copete (Mallorca) replaces Daniel Rodriguez.
86' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) is cautioned by the referee.
86' The referee shows the yellow card to Aimar Oroz (Osasuna).
86' Here is a change. Jon Moncayola is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna).
82' Here comes a substitution. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Vedat Muriqi.
82' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Jan Salas (Mallorca) replaces Robert Navarro.
81' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Sergio Herrera no chance!
80' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

80' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. PENALTY! One of the players from Mallorca is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
79' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
78' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) took the corner.

78' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the roof of the net lacks power and Dominik Greif easily makes the save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' The ball goes out of play and Dominik Greif (Mallorca) takes a goal kick.
74' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
73' The attendance for today's match is 15378.

72' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Adrian Cordero who sees an offensive foul. Mallorca win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
71' The statistic for corner kicks – 7:5.
69' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) got into an offside position. It was tight, but it's not the first time he got caught today.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Darder leaves the pitch and Takuma Asano (Mallorca) comes on.
67' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. Mallorca will take a free kick near the side line.
65' Samu Costa (Mallorca) commits a foul and Adrian Cordero immediately signals a free kick. Osasuna have a free kick.
64' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
63' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a long ball forward to Vedat Muriqi, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.

61' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Sergio Herrera is equal to it and makes an easy save. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
60' Substitution. Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) did his best and is replaced by Abel Bretones.
60' Here's the change. Juan Cruz (Osasuna) leaves the pitch and Moi Gomez comes on as a substitute.
58' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) whips in a cross from the corner, but Sergio Herrera is well positioned and punches the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
58' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
56' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
56' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Mallorca.
55' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
53' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) tackles a bit over-zealously and Adrian Cordero blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Mallorca, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
52' It's a throw-in for Osasuna.

50' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
49' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Dominik Greif (Mallorca) leaps to collect the ball. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
49' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
47' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vicente Moreno probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Lucas Torro (Osasuna). He is replaced by Iker Munoz.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

43' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends a lofted pass into the penalty area from a free kick, but the opposition's defence manages to control all the attacking players and thwart the threat. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
43' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca get a free kick.
41' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The linesman signals a throw-in for Mallorca.
39' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. A free kick to Osasuna.
38' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
37' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

35' Dominik Greif leaps like a salmon to deny Aimar Oroz (Osasuna), whose effort is headed to the top left corner of the goal, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
35' Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to Lucas Torro (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
34' The ball goes wide of the goal and out for a goal kick. It looks like Dominik Greif (Mallorca) is going to take it.

32' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
31' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle and it's Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Osasuna have a free kick.
29' 3:4 – the corner kicks stats.

27' He should have scored! Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Dominik Greif makes an easy save. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
25' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is about to take a goal kick.
23' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
21' The ball is cleared after Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
19' The ball has crossed the sideline. Osasuna are taking a throw-in.
18' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
17' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
16' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Osasuna force a corner. They send men into the box.
16' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The referee signals a corner kick to Osasuna.
14' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
12' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
10' Samu Costa (Mallorca) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Osasuna.
9' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) will take a goal kick to hopefully start an attacking move for his team.
8' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent. Mallorca have been awarded a free kick.
7' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) and Aimar Oroz combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
5' A cross from a corner kick by Mallorca is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
4' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mallorca.
3' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
2' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
1' The ball is behind the touchline and Mallorca will take a throw-in.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero will officiate today.
